description: Angular component for a dashboard UI, managing widgets, layout, and interactions within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DashboardComponent
classes.description: Main Angular component class for rendering and managing a customizable dashboard with widgets.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes dashboard settings, widget layout, and event subscriptions.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and observers on component destruction.

methods.name: ngDoCheck
methods.description: Performs custom change detection logic.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes to update layout and widget states.

methods.name: updateWidgets
methods.description: Updates the widget collection in the dashboard.

methods.name: updateWidgetLayouts
methods.description: Updates widget layout configurations.

methods.name: onUpdateTimewindow
methods.description: Handles updates to the dashboard's time window.

methods.name: onResetTimewindow
methods.description: Resets the dashboard's time window to the original.

methods.name: isAutofillHeight
methods.description: Determines if the dashboard should autofill height based on device size.

methods.name: onDashboardMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events on the dashboard.

methods.name: openDashboardContextMenu
methods.description: Opens context menu for the dashboard.

methods.name: openWidgetContextMenu
methods.description: Opens context menu for a specific widget.

methods.name: onWidgetFullscreenChanged
methods.description: Handles widget fullscreen toggle.

methods.name: onWidgetComponentAction
methods.description: Handles actions from widget components.

methods.name: widgetMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down event on a widget.

methods.name: widgetClicked
methods.description: Handles click event on a widget.

methods.name: editWidget
methods.description: Triggers widget editing.

methods.name: replaceReferenceWithWidgetCopy
methods.description: Replaces widget reference with a copy.

methods.name: exportWidget
methods.description: Exports widget data.

methods.name: removeWidget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the dashboard.

methods.name: highlightWidget
methods.description: Highlights a widget by ID.

methods.name: selectWidget
methods.description: Selects a widget by ID.

methods.name: getSelectedWidget
methods.description: Returns the currently selected widget.

methods.name: getEventGridPosition
methods.description: Calculates widget grid position from an event.

methods.name: resetHighlight
methods.description: Resets widget highlight.

methods.name: scrollToWidget
methods.description: Scrolls view to a specific widget.

methods.name: onGridsterParentResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for the grid container.

methods.name: updateGridOpts
methods.description: Updates grid layout options based on device size and settings.

methods.name: updateColumnOpts
methods.description: Updates column layout options.

methods.name: updateEditingOpts
methods.description: Updates widget editing options.

methods.name: updateDisplayGridOpts
methods.description: Updates grid display options.

methods.name: notifyGridsterOptionsChanged
methods.description: Notifies gridster of configuration changes.

methods.name: pauseChangeNotifications
methods.description: Pauses change notifications.

methods.name: resumeChangeNotifications
methods.description: Resumes change notifications.

methods.name: notifyLayoutUpdated
methods.description: Triggers layout update.

methods.name: detectRowSize
methods.description: Calculates row height based on device and layout.

methods.name: checkIsMobileSize
methods.description: Determines if current device size is mobile.
